def initial_dot_surname(first, last):
    """The night editor at the Millbrook Gazette will not send the morning
    edition to press until every byline matches the house style sheet. She
    slides two slips of paper across the desk — a contributor's given name
    and family name — and asks you to typeset the credit line exactly as
    the style sheet demands. first and last are non-empty lowercase-letter
    strings. Return exactly the string '<F>. <Last>' where <F> is the first
    letter of first converted to uppercase, then a dot and a single space,
    then last with ONLY its first letter converted to uppercase. Get it
    wrong, she warns, and the compositors reset the whole column by hand.

    >>> initial_dot_surname('ada', 'lovelace')
    'A. Lovelace'
    >>> initial_dot_surname('x', 'y')
    'X. Y'
    """
